description: This file defines the SeriesCollection class, which manages a collection of data series (likely for charts) in the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel.Shapes.Charts namespace. It provides methods for constructing, cloning, adding series, serializing, and accessing series within the collection.

classes.name: SeriesCollection
classes.description: Represents a collection of data series used in chart rendering. Provides functionality for managing series items, cloning, serialization, and meta-information.

methods.name: SeriesCollection()
methods.description: Constructor initializing the collection with default SeriesCollectionValues.

methods.name: SeriesCollection(DocumentObject parent)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the collection with a specified parent document object.

methods.name: this[int index]
methods.description: Indexer to get a specific Series by index, casting from base collection.

methods.name: Clone()
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of this SeriesCollection.

methods.name: AddSeries()
methods.description: Adds a new Series object to the collection and returns it.

methods.name: Serialize(Serializer serializer)
methods.description: Serializes each Series in the collection using the provided serializer.

classes.name: SeriesCollectionValues
classes.description: Holds the internal property values for the SeriesCollection, associated with a specific DocumentObject owner.
